subject: Reminder: Volunteer list update
text:
Hi,

I wanted to remind you that the neighborhood welcome committee is collecting volunteer names by the end of this week. The committee is finalizing the schedule this Friday, and a few spots are still open. I know our plans shifted after the budget review, so I understand if you need more time before deciding.

If you can help with the spring planning session, a short reply would be enough. Otherwise, no problem at all. Please just let me know so I can update the list.

Thank you for considering it.
